# `trufflehog.yml`

## Inputs

| Name | Description | Type | Default | Required |
| :--- | :---------- | :--- | :------ | :------: |
| allow_fork_prs | Allow fork PRs to run this workflow (set false for self-hosted runners) | `boolean` | `true` | no |
| exclude_paths | Path to a file of newline-separated regex path excludes, relative to the repo root. Empty (default) excludes nothing. | `string` | `` | no |
| extra_args | Extra flags appended to the trufflehog invocation. Do NOT pass --fail here: the action already runs the CLI with `--fail --no-update --github-actions` and appends this after, and trufflehog's flag parser rejects a repeated flag outright ("flag 'fail' cannot be repeated"). The GitLab template's default was `--only-verified --fail` because it invoked the CLI directly; only the first half carries over. | `string` | `--only-verified` | no |
| full_history | Force a full-history scan even on a pull_request event | `boolean` | `false` | no |
| runner_labels | Runner labels as JSON array (e.g., ["self-hosted", "oke"]) | `string` | `["ubuntu-24.04"]` | no |
